knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A stone quote shows the scope, the controls, the exclusions and the cure time as well as the price.
Controls take time and equipment. Removing them to lower a price is not a valid saving.
Uncertain identification is a condition of the quote, and the variation rule applies if it turns out to be engineered stone.
Identification, test patches, the sequence and documentation are part of the scope and are priced.
A lesson or a quote does not grant a licence, permit, notification exemption or authority to do regulated work.

practicalCriteria: Lists every control as a priced line item on the quote
Includes exclusions and a variation clause
Does not remove controls to match a lower price
Obtains written approval before work starts
passRule: Knowledge checks: 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate and is not granted by the knowledge check: an assessor must observe every critical practical criterion and record it.
evidenceRequired: Quote with priced controls, exclusions and variation clause
stopWorkCriteria: Client asks for controls to be removed to reduce the price
Engineered stone work without a confirmed regulator-compliant route
